usage_rule: Use null for unavailable authoritative provider metering. Do not estimate or fabricate usage. Preserve original response metering and independently bind external receipts when available.
instructions: Return one JSON object only, with the exact response fields and all sixteen original branch positions in order. Add no markdown wrapper.
Jointly reason over the whole population in one semantic batch. Preserve useful diversity across instruction and assembly strategies rather than rewriting every branch into one identical policy.

Optimize complete consumption templates using anonymous abstract behavior and measured complete-system quality, intent, reliability and mean/non-first sample latency. Treat small-panel changes as optimization signals, not demonstrated generalization.

Prioritize joint Solver/Reviewer evidence use, then organization and handoff, then Planner revision/termination, then Perception presentation. Preserve exact executable output/interface contracts found in the full parent templates.

Keep knowledge, retrieval, construction, data, tools, parsers, scorers, answer authority, decoding, scheduler and serving geometry fixed. Never request source rosters, utterances, entity values, raw reasoning or per-sample semantic summaries.

Replace each edited role with its complete English text. A changes.role_text object may include only the edited roles; omitted roles are inherited. If editing context_layout or node_context, supply that complete object with the exact keys and one supported value for every key.

Use the branch-specific evaluated parent identity. Cross-branch numeric evidence may motivate ideas, but do not alter ancestry hashes or expose private provenance; the archive retains cumulative exposure.
Use changes={} for no-change. Keep all sixteen slots, including unsuccessful hypotheses; never silently replace, repair or request extra proposals.
Return experience_operations=[] for this template-only update. Express learned general rules in proposed templates, and keep rationale/hypotheses concise and abstract.
